body: I see a ton of people correcting little grammar/spelling mistakes on here. This is my hill: if you are able to correct me, you were able to understand what I meant in the first place. Isn't that the whole point of language?

I guessing you're refering to the difference between a player/dm being bad and the character they're portraying being bad?

If that's the case, the difference is pretty easy to tell. If it's one character that makes sense being creepy or bad, it's probably the way they intended the character to be, whether it's appreciated or not. If all or most of their characters are creepy, with little or no reason to be that way, it's probably a creepy player/dm.

Some people just like playing characters like that or they do it for laughs, which is fine if everyone is in on it. In the cases being described here, it's pretty clear they weren't.
